verdict.rationale: Highnote documents a Test environment that 'replicates the full functionality of the Live environment' and lets you 'simulate real-time transactions' (docs-11). It also explicitly says you can 'simulate authorizations, refunds, and statements' (docs-26), and collaborative authorization and spend rules provide the approve/decline logic to test (docs-7, docs-8). missing for 10: explicit documentation of simulating clearings, reversals and declines in the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox lifecycle simulation.
